title: 路径变形
asks: 矢量路径变形时，是走单纯的坐标线性插值，还是分解为相似变换（旋放）加极坐标残差形变？
asksEn: When morphing vector paths, do you linearly interpolate coordinates, or decompose into similarity rotation/scale plus polar residual deformation?
summary: 矢量路径变形。2D Procrustes 相似分解求解旋转与缩放，极坐标插值杜绝弦长塌陷，角点锚定保证静止态保真。
summaryEn: Vector path morphing. 2D Procrustes solves rotation and scale in closed form; polar interpolation avoids chord collapse; corner anchors ensure endpoint fidelity.

links.whenEn: vector path morphing is not container box stretching
